state_tokenization: Each document is tokenized independently and followed by the independently tokenized fixed double-newline delimiter before token-id concatenation. This constructively prevents BPE boundary changes when a new document is appended.
redesign_rationale: The untouched seed-387803 0.5B/1.5B/3B complete-state panel established a positive global Foundation-by-state interaction and strong 0.5B/3B gains, but the 1.5B safety gate closed. This separately generated untouched seed tests whether the middle result is checkpoint-local by extending the same Qwen2.5 family to 7B. It supplements and never replaces the retained 1.5B failure.
reader_contract: The reader sees only the official prompt and question, never the answer or support labels. Deterministic BM25 seeds and exact title links produce one nested document order; complete documents are append-only across states.
dual_path_contract: The identical charged complete-document state feeds a compact evidence distribution and Qwen2 latent replay at relative depth 0.875. A sample-clustered safe simplex includes exact Foundation and opens only for a positive paired 95% calibration LCB.

state_budget_rule.formula: B_s = round_half_up(512 * (d_s / 896)^0.5), giving 512/774/1024 for hidden widths 896/2048/3584
state_budget_rule.selection: A prospectively fixed width-sublinear law grows absolute ASCENT capacity at every endpoint while targeting decreasing capacity bytes per Foundation parameter. The final score-free audit must show all selected documents are complete; otherwise this design fails before scoring.
state_budget_rule.charged_bytes: actual replay tokens * (hidden_size * 2 bfloat16 bytes + 8 int64 token-id bytes)
state_budget_rule.relative_cost_gate: Maximum-budget, observed actual co-scaled, and fixed-small-state bytes per parameter must each strictly decrease. Absolute co-scaled state capacity must strictly increase.

primary_estimand: paired per-example Foundation minus effective dual-path ASCENT answer NLL on 40 untouched test rows
factorial_estimand: Adjacent and global Foundation-by-state interactions from the complete 3x3 panel, each requiring a positive paired 95% LCB

controls.fixed: complete graph_small state on every Foundation
controls.memory_only_scaling: all three complete graph states on every Foundation
controls.query_only: co-scale-matched complete BM25 documents without graph expansion
controls.path_ablations: certified-only and latent-only NLL saved before fusion

development_success_rule.co_scaled_gain: Every diagonal safe gate opens and every endpoint NLL-gain LCB is positive.
development_success_rule.scale_complementarity: Both adjacent diagonal-gain LCBs and the log-parameter slope LCB are positive.
development_success_rule.foundation_state_interaction: Both adjacent factorial-interaction LCBs and the global interaction LCB are positive.
development_success_rule.fixed_control: Co-scaled beats complete Graph Small at 3B and 7B with positive LCBs.
development_success_rule.retrieval_controls: Graph beats query-only at 7B and irrelevant at every endpoint with positive LCBs.
development_success_rule.dual_path: A diagonal gate selects certified weight somewhere and latent weight somewhere.
development_success_rule.systems: All exact hash/commit/clean-tree/native/no-label/shared-state/prefix/cross-Foundation identity, increasing absolute capacity, and decreasing-relative-state gates pass.

promotion_rule: Only development_pass=true authorizes official generation and three new confirmation seeds. Seed 388803 cannot be tuned into confirmation.
failure_rule: Any missed gate is retained as failure; seed 387803 and its 1.5B failure remain in all reports regardless of this extension.
ceiling_policy: Continuous answer NLL is primary. Later accuracy reports absolute gain and prospectively frozen remaining-error elimination; perfect ASCENT is 100% error elimination, never a demand above 1.0. A perfect Foundation cell is saturated/undefined rather than failed.
